name: tekken8-roger-jr-all-players-nov-17
lines: هو كنغر صغير يقاتل من جيب أمه

اتُّهم ظلمًا فانطلق مع أمه
لمواجهة خصومهما
headline:
يُطرح Roger Jr. للجميع
في TEKKEN 8 الثلاثاء
label: رسمي
spoken: يُطرح Roger Jr. للجميع في TEKKEN 8 الثلاثاء. هو كنغر صغير يقاتل من جيب أمه. اتُّهم ظلمًا، فانطلق مع أمه لمواجهة خصومهما.

angle.hook: a joey who fights from his mother's pouch, Roger Jr., opens to every TEKKEN 8 player
angle.why_now: Bandai Namco America's 10 Nov release: all players on 16 Nov (North America); the trailer slate and the 12 Oct release give 17 Nov (CET), Tuesday in the Gulf
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf TEKKEN 8 players on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam can buy him from Tuesday; Season 3 Pass holders have had him since 12 Nov
angle.payoff: the mother and joey pair in their summer outfit at sunset

story_type_items.OUT NOW (release dated): platforms: TEKKEN 8 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam (Bandai Namco release); date: 16 Nov North America / 17 Nov CET (Tuesday in the Gulf); price: none listed yet (Steam DLC page 4536150 shows no price on 15 Nov), said in the caption; what it is: the third Season 3 fighter, a joey fighting from his mother's pouch

decision_log: source: Bandai Namco's official Roger Jr. gameplay trailer, IGN 1920x1080 60 fps MP4 (4.6 Mbps, 255 s), decode clean on the server; no newer trailer exists as a file (the 10 Nov trailer and 12 Nov Starter Guide are YouTube only, Steam DLC 4536150 has no movie, IGN has no launch trailer). The same trailer carried the 12 Oct date post; this Reel uses different shots (the pouch close-ups and the summer outfit) for the general release

beat 1 hook 0-2.0 s: 33.63 s low-angle hero shot, mother boxing the air and Roger Jr. punching from the pouch (evidence_role illustration); crop 0.43 keeps both; alternative 29.25 close-up rejected as cover because the mother's face would sit under the headline band

beat 1b 2.0-2.8 s: 36.6 s the pair close, joey's gloves up (crop 0.40; 35.63-36.5 rejected: the kangaroo is half-cut at the right edge of the window); ends 37.42 before the 'ROGER Jr.' title card at 37.48
breath 2.8-4.6 s: 18.9 s close of the joey then the jump into the sky (crop 0.291), no line

line 1 4.6-8.3 s 'هو كنغر صغير يقاتل من جيب أمه': 20.75 s low-angle pair with the joey's red gloves raised (crop 0.45), then 29.25 s close-up of the joey in the pouch with the 'Mum' necklace (crop 0.512); demonstration of the pouch fighter

line 2 8.3-13.5 s 'اتُّهم ظلمًا فانطلق مع أمه / لمواجهة خصومهما': 65.25 s mother and joey in matching hats at sunset, 92.67 s the hat close-up shadowboxing at sunset (ends 95.22 before the white flash), 144.7 s close of the pair (crop 0.5; starts after the super move's hit on an opponent); picture: the two together
left out: every shot with an opponent being hit, the 61-62 s punching bag with 'Dad' printed on it, the 152 s pot throw, title and date slates, the Yujiro Hanma section (speech from 212 s)
sound: one stretch of the trailer from 33.63 s, music_only (music stem under the whole Reel, no effects); faster-whisper small on the whole trailer: no speech before 212.5 s
template trailer: no card, the headline carries the news; Monday so far split 2, trailer 1, clipcard 1; the 07:15 neighbour is Littlelands (Apogee), a different game and publisher

v2 (qc v1 fail: length 10.7 s before the end card; v1 strip: the cover's chip and credit line sat over the mother's face): hard cuts (cut true, the trailer's own cutting style) so the crossfades no longer eat 2.8 s; cover starts at 34.0 s where the mother's head is above the text rows (gloves raised), then 176.23 s the summer outfit on the beach with the joey boxing the air (crop 0.538; the 'COSTUME 3' label sits outside the 9:16 window, server shots read clean) under the headline; line 1 over the jump, the low-angle pair and the pouch close-up; line 2 over the sunset pair, the 'Mum' close and the sunset hat close-up; the 32.0 s tail kick was tried and left out (the kicking leg leaves the 9:16 window)
